# PDFly by 3idhMinds

> Free universal PDF generator and REST API. Convert text or HTML to PDF in 70+ languages, convert 25+ image formats to PDF, all with client-side processing where possible — your files never leave your browser.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, and live demo.
- [PDF Generator App](/app): Web UI to generate PDFs from text using 15 templates.
- [Text to PDF](/text-to-pdf): Feature page for text/HTML to PDF conversion.
- [Image to PDF](/image-to-pdf): Feature page for converting images to PDF.
- [Convert Images](/images-to-pdf): Web UI to combine 100+ images into a single PDF.
- [API Documentation](/docs): REST API reference, code samples, authentication, rate limits.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free tier details and upcoming Pro plans.
- [Status](/status): Live system status for API and edge functions.
- [Blog](/blog): Tutorials and guides on PDF generation.
